Manage the rollout of a project

Usage: slipway rollout [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Available Commands:
  history  View rollout history
  undo     Undo a previous rollout
  unpin    Stop holding a project at a revision
  pause    Mark the provided project as paused
  resume   Resume a paused project

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway rollout <COMMAND> --help" for more information about a given command.
Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
